title: RPGM tests
description: Comprehensive tests for RPGM implementation including: reference point movement following random waypoint, group member positions staying within bounded variance of reference point, correct behavior at boundaries, and integration with the mobility model framework.
close_reason: Coverage verified against bead bullets: reference point random-waypoint movement (test_reference_point_moves_random_waypoint_style, test_pauses_at_waypoint), bounded member variance (test_offsets_bounded_and_drawn_once, test_members_track_reference_point), boundaries (test_reference_point_starts_clamped_into_inset, test_members_stay_within_bounds), framework integration (test_attach_and_step_all, test_reset_clears_membership_and_state, test_seed_reproducibility). 18 tests in test_rpgm.py, all green.
